Video.summary: Learn more about this infamous Robot and the family that built it. With an unforgettable design and devastating weapon, this competitor became an instant icon.
Video.title: Ultimate Collection: Hypno-Disc

Video.summary: Debuting in the Second Wars, to becoming the most successful Robot ever to take part in Robot Wars. This Robot put the squeeze on all the competition, including the House Robots.
Video.title: Ultimate Collection: Razer

Video.summary: Newcomers, veterans and a recent President enter the fray in this first Heat of the series. Competitors are eliminated left, right and centre and only the strongest will survive to compete in the finals.
Video.title: Series 10 - Heat A

Video.summary: A veteran only heat features the current reigning Champions, Carbide. Will Carbide’s streak be brought to an end by the other robots, more experienced and eager than ever?
Video.title: Series 10 - Heat B

Video.summary: Witness the human drama of competitor’s desperation for victory and the resulting mechanical carnage.
Video.title: Revealed - Episode 11

Video.summary: Follow the exploits of teams all over the country as they battle it out in hopes of becoming champion.
Video.title: Revealed - Episode 12

Video.summary: The pace steps up a gear as Philippa investigates behind the scenes of the series’ first Semi-finals.
Video.title: Revealed - Episode 13

Video.summary: The second round of semi-finals follows six more teams that have made it through the heats and are one step closer to Grand Final.
Video.title: Revealed - Episode 14

Video.summary: Four robotic warriors have battled their way to the Grand Final. The other competitors have been sent to a scrapheap. See what it’s like behind the scenes of the most intense stage of the competition.
Video.title: Revealed - Episode 15

Video.summary: Even the judges aren’t safe as two robots collide, sending shrapnel through the bullet-resistant shields around the arena. Two very different styles of robot meet in the finals.
Video.title: Series 10 - Heat C

Video.summary: One newcomer stares down seven veterans, will their induction into the arena be successful, or will their inexperience find them in the pit? One robot will have a second chance to qualify in the Redemption Round.
Video.title: Series 10 - Heat D

Video.summary: The final heat features only veterans, here for an opportunity to make up for their mistakes in the previous tournaments. Only one competitor will make it into the Grand Finals, and the others must suffer defeat, again.

Video.summary: After lengthy repairs and inspirational pep talks, the qualifiers prepare to fight for the title. A 10-way Robot Rumble will give the victor a spot in the Grand Finals, alongside the heat winners.
Video.title: Series 10 - Grand Final

Video.summary: The first of sixteen Heats in the seventh series. The four-way melees kick off the competition with true carnage. Sir Killalot may have changed the tide of battle during the finals.
Video.title: The Seventh Wars - Heat A

Video.summary: The second round of heats sees eight new robots join the fight for The Seventh Wars title. Growler is de-muzzled as he rampages through the arena in the four-way melees, no-one is safe.
Video.title: The Seventh Wars - Heat B

Video.summary: After the four-way melees, the house robots do not hesitate to get involved with the remaining competitors. A counter-attack leads to one of the shortest finals robot wars has ever seen.
Video.title: The Seventh Wars - Heat C

Video.summary: An equal number of newcomers and veterans take to the battlefield in this episode, experience versus vigor in today’s heats. The innocent Refbot gets attacked after cease is called.
Video.title: The Seventh Wars - Heat D

Video.summary: The Sixth Wars champions return to the arena to battle for the Seventh Wars title. Do they still have what it takes to win, or will the competition be too fierce this time round?
Video.title: The Seventh Wars - Heat E

Video.summary: A newcomer from Germany joins the UK competitors in this week’s heats. Will they put show the UK how it’s done, or will the other robots have a home advantage?
Video.title: The Seventh Wars - Heat F

Video.summary: Another German joins the roster this week. One robot becomes an eviction technician, removing their opponents from the arena. Refbot joins the fray as he helps pit an immobilised robot.
Video.title: The Seventh Wars - Heat G

Video.summary: A robot representing the Netherlands fights with the Brits in this heat. After attempting to attack one of the house robots, Growler makes an example of one of the competitors. Matilda uses her flywheel in spectacular fashion.
Video.title: The Seventh Wars - Heat H

Video.summary: One hapless robot gets expertly dismantled by another competitor, leaving Refbot to count them out. Maybe the house robots should take notes. A Hail Mary charge leaves yet another robot out of the arena.
Video.title: The Seventh Wars - Heat I

Video.summary: The Seventh Wars continues, eight more robots with high hopes of becoming champion enter the arena. One robot has to see a man about a dog, as Mr. Psycho and Growler team up on a competitor.
Video.title: The Seventh Wars - Heat J

Video.summary: Only one team can win the £20,000 cash prize, and they could be competing in this week’s heat. A close first round leaves it up to the judges to decide who will progress through the heat.
Video.title: The Seventh Wars - Heat K

Video.summary: A newcomer has an aggressive start to their first battle, with no competitor or house robot left unchallenged. Will they make it all the way to final or be punished for their hubris?
Video.title: The Seventh Wars - Heat L
